title: Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? (October 2026)
text: Please lead with either SEEKING WORK or SEEKING FREELANCER, your location, and whether remote work is a possibility. Please only post if you are looking to hire a freelancer or work as one. Small (2-5 person) agencies are fine, but recruiters, job boards, and so on, are off topic here.
triage_reason: Monthly hiring thread for employers seeking freelancers or contractors.
